PDF Visualization of Octree Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) in Astrophysical ...
Compared to grid based AMR, the Octree AMR has the ad- vantage to ﬁt very precisely the adaptive resolution of the grid to the local problem complexity. However, this speciﬁc octree data type need some speciﬁc software to be visualized, as generic visualization tools works on Cartesian grid data type.
